title: Existence of the Lyapunov exponent for $S$-unimodal maps
summary: In this paper, we show that for any $S$-unimodal map $T$ on $[0,1]$ with a non-flat critical point the Lyapunov exponent exists for Lebesgue almost every point and is equal to a constant $λ_T\in\mathbb{R}$. Moreover, $λ_T=0$ if and only if $T$ admits neither an absolutely continuous $T$-invariant probability measure with positive entropy nor a strictly stable periodic orbit.
